reviewed_by: lead source-to-binary review against evidence sheet sections 12-17
review_scope: QTask_AllocateEvent: 6-byte event-table scan from id 0x20, three-field store, event id return and the exhaustion branch

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Entry 0x004017C0 recovered exactly by both Binary Ninja and radare2 CFG with the same extent 0x004017C0-0x0040180C.

checks.name: cfg_match
checks.rationale: bn=6/7 r2=6/7, CFG similarity 1.000, above the 0.85 threshold.

checks.name: scan_bounds
checks.rationale: Retail scans 0x0054F9F2 to 0x54FF26 with a 6-byte stride from id 0x20; the candidate tests the same bounds through event_table_entry_count = 0x5F4/6 = 254 and first_event_id = 0x20.

checks.name: store_order
checks.rationale: Retail 0x4017F7 sets +2, 0x4017FD stores one 16-bit word at +0, 0x401804 sets +3. The candidate's emitted order is verified identical in the frozen artifact (0x41a3fc, 0x41a403, 0x41a40a) after the volatile ordering fix.

checks.name: return_value
checks.rationale: Retail leaves the full id in EAX (inc eax at 0x4017D2); the candidate returns std::uint32_t and the emitted sequence is mov %edx,%eax.

checks.name: exhaustion_path
checks.rationale: Retail pushes 0x5361A8 ('Unable to allocate event'), calls Debug_Error 0x4AF7B0 and jumps to itself at 0x4017E8. The candidate calls Debug_Error with the same literal and then self-spins; verified in the artifact at 0x41a430.

limitations: The allocation path is not reached before the startup boundary, so no runtime observation exists for a successful allocation or for exhaustion; the review is source-to-binary plus emitted-code comparison only.
Status remains STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED: no Frida probe has observed this native in either binary.

runtime_contract.reason: Native is unreachable in the current build because QTask_Init runs before it and the startup boundary stops execution earlier.
